title: Craftable Horse & Nautlis Armor
description: Adds the ability to craft Horse and Nautilus Armor!
body:
# Craftable Horse & Nautilus Armor
Made by [**8bitdino**](https://www.youtube.com/@8bitdino) with **100% human** trial & error :3
## Description
This datapack allows you to craft every Horse and Nautilus Armor, making them renewable!

This is designed to work with my [Better Non-Renewables Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/uglZSVKi)!
## Affected Items
- Copper Horse Armor
- Iron Horse Armor
- Golden Horse Armor
- Diamond Horse Armor
- Copper Nautilus Armor
- Iron Nautilus Armor
- Golden Nautilus Armor
- Diamond Nautilus Armor
## Recipes Added
All Horse Armor recipes are based on the Leather Horse Armor crafting recipe. Netherite Horse and Nautilus Armor are already craftable via smithing.
## IMPORTANT
> This datapack moves the **Leather Horse Armor** crafting recipe to the "Equipment" category in the crafting table recipe interface. This is to be in line with the **Saddle**, **Happy Ghast Harness**, and **Wolf Armor**.
## More
I have no idea why Leather Horse Armor is sorted into Misc by default.

Please let me know if any bugs/issues arise by submitting a report through the dedicated [Google Form](https://forms.gle/UnCkA96xm5q3CV6a8)!
